title: Target shooting on Crown land: the rules
note: Rules for shooting a firearm or bow for practice outside a range. Crown land means public land owned by the province. Hunting seasons do not matter for practice; these place rules do.

rules.h: Is target shooting on Crown land allowed?
rules.t: VERIFY. No official BC page was found that says, in plain words, that target shooting on open Crown land is allowed or banned in general. The bans below are tied to places. Outside them, ask the regional Fish and Wildlife office or the Conservation Officer Service before you set up.
No firing a firearm in a No Shooting Area. Bows and crossbows are allowed there unless the region restricts them. Most are drawn only on the synopsis maps, not in this app.

rules.h: 100 m (109 yd) from houses, schools and farm buildings
rules.t: No firing a firearm within 100 m of a church, school building or school yard, playground, regional district park, dwelling house, or a farm or ranch building with people or domestic animals in it. The rule says "hunt or discharge a firearm", so it covers target practice too.

No firing across, or within, the road allowance of a numbered highway or a 2 lane or wider public road: 15 m (16 yd) each side of the middle of a road under 3 lanes. The Wildlife Act also bans firing on or across the travelled part of a highway.

rules.h: Not from a vehicle or motorboat
rules.t: No firing a firearm from a motor vehicle, or from a boat pushed by a motor.

No firing a firearm, bow or crossbow on or into the developed part of a recreation site or interpretive forest: 100 m (109 yd) in every direction from a structure, day use area, campsite or trail staging area. On a recreation trail, only where a ban is posted.

When a park is closed to hunting, or no season is open, both carrying and firing a firearm or bow are banned unless a park officer allows it. Hunting is the only shooting the synopsis allows in a park, so do not target shoot in a park (my reading).
No firing a firearm or bow in an ecological reserve. No hunting in any national park.
Most municipalities restrict firearms and bows by bylaw. Bylaws are not in the synopsis: ask the municipal clerk. Many regional district parks ban firearms and bows too.
No firing firearms or bows on Crown land, or in Lac du Bois Grasslands Protected Area, inside the City of Kamloops boundary. The city bylaw for other land: VERIFY with the city.

In 2017 the province made no shooting zones within 400 m (437 yd) of select roads on Crown land outside towns in the Fraser Valley Regional District. They cover recreational shooting and target practice, not licensed hunting. Check the current maps: the zones may have changed since 2017.

rules.h: Private land and First Nations reserves
rules.t: You need the owner's permission. A reserve is treated like private land: ask the Nation. Town bylaws and the 100 m rule still apply on private land.
A restricted or prohibited firearm may be kept only at your home or at a place a chief firearms officer authorizes, such as an approved range. So no handgun practice on Crown land.
When a campfire ban is on, the BC Wildfire Service often also bans binary exploding targets. Check the bans for your fire centre on the day. Tracer ammunition: VERIFY (no official BC rule found).

rules.t: It is a crime to use or handle a firearm or ammunition in a careless way, or without reasonable care for other people's safety.

items.t: A solid earth bank or hillside behind the target, tall enough to catch a miss. Never the sky or a ridge top.

items.t: Nothing past it: no people, road, trail, livestock, house or building.
items.tag: Tip, and your safety course rule

items.t: A bullet that misses keeps going: a .308 bullet can travel kilometres, a .22 well over 1 km.
No rocks, water or frozen ground in front of or behind the target: low bullets skip.
Paper or cardboard targets on a stand. No glass, cans or steel close up.
At least 100 m (109 yd) from any house or occupied farm building, and out of the road allowance.
Walk the shooting lane before you load. Look past the target every time.
Pack out every target, shell and piece of brass.
